purpose: Design-only seed projection for VDT. No accounts provisioned, no credentials generated, no CRM entities imported, no runtime tests performed.
merge_algorithm: Verify source hashes and FLOW.base_sha256; fail on mismatch.
Select only baseline roles/users where application == VDT; preserve user fields and role.scope exactly.
Union permissions by exact role ID from baseline, FLOW permission_additions, then explicit step05 extensions; unknown role or permission is an error.
Sort effective permission codes lexicographically; keep per-grant provenance.
Materialize explicit design role assignments as RBAC-05-03; these are not inferred runtime grants.
Do not create passwords, real MFA enrollment, CRM accounts, evidence, assessments or approval decisions.

permission_catalog.description: Resolve dispute using authorized independent adjudicator and a new snapshot with linked rationale.
Append an independent review of assigned work by a different actor; preserves original findings.
Create control/risk/retest snapshots using eligible scoped inputs and frozen rule versions.
Maintain scoped control implementations and versioned definitions/criteria; no rewrite of used versions.
Read metadata/content only when current assignment covers the evidence and linked assessment.
Request additional evidence inside assigned assessments; request does not supply evidence or verify it.
Submit a new evidence revision for a scoped evidence item through upload policy and commit recheck.
Append verification for the exact revision/scope; self verification does not imply independent review.
Read/create/update scoped VDT inventory; mutable updates require current version.
Maintain organization and branch metadata within explicit organization scope.
Read/create export of authorized immutable report snapshots; current scope still filters access.
Record explicit risk acceptance with rationale/conditions; never changes control result or closes gaps by itself.
Review and confirm business impact within owned/authorized risk; preserves provenance.
Approve cross-scenario operational priority for owned/authorized risk with reason and time.
Propose scenario/context/factor inputs; proposal is not approval of priority or acceptance.
Grant/revoke scoped VDT role assignments with expiry and audit; no implied domain evidence access.
Approve treatment and append gap/task closure decision after checking explicit closure criteria.
Create/update scoped treatment tasks with current version; cannot approve closure.
Manage VDT users and disable/revoke them; never provision CRM identities through VDT.

roles.scope_constraint: Organization assessments/evidence within assigned operational scope; U002 uses ASM-DEMO-01 in these cases.
Owned/authorized risks in the organization; U003 owns CRM in these cases.
Assigned assessments and linked evidence only; existing access_expires_at applies.

users.label: Chủ sở hữu rủi ro CRM

branches.label: Chi nhánh Đà Nẵng — giả lập

object_scope.ownership_rule: risk owner U003 or explicit audited delegation

step05_permission_extensions.reason: TUC-08 needs internal self-assessment reporting in the same explicitly assigned operational scope; no consultant dependency.
constraints: Filter report snapshot and every referenced item by current scope.
Export/download recheck authorization and expiry; evidence bytes still require evidence.read_assigned.

step05_permission_extensions.reason: Resolve an assessment dispute by an explicit authorized decision and a new immutable snapshot; do not overwrite either original finding.
constraints: Must be authorized for the assessment and owned or explicitly delegated risk.
Adjudicator must differ from both original assessor and disputed reviewer.
If no independent authorized actor exists, retain NEEDS_REVIEW; do not relax identity separation.
This grant is not assessment.run, evidence.verify, assessment.review, or SME approval of fixture risk priorities.

scope_materialization.reason: Baseline roles carry abstract scope. Materialize two branches and ASM-DEMO-01 for deterministic design cases without converting a user's home branch or generic role into authorization.
rules: For U001 only organization/user/role administration; no implied evidence/report read.
U002 operational grant and U003 ownership grant explicitly cover BR-HCM and BR-DN for AST-CRM/ASM-DEMO-01.
U004 remains limited to ASM-DEMO-01 and linked evidence; both branches are covered only through that assigned assessment.
All specified scope dimensions intersect. A matching branch without matching assessment/asset cannot grant access.
Future assessments/assets/branches are denied until an explicit authorized grant includes them.
user.branch_id is profile metadata and never alone grants or denies a branch operation.
Actual deployment must bind fixture symbolic IDs to same-organization seeded DB IDs and validate all referenced records before enabling a grant.

policy_invariants: Deny by default; authenticated VDT session AND active user AND permission AND current explicit object scope AND not revoked AND current server time before all applicable expiries.
Effective expiry is the earliest applicable session, user, assignment and assessment-access expiry; null means no additional limit, not a bypass.
Independent review and adjudication enforce actor separation; adding another role to the same principal cannot satisfy independence.
Recheck authorization at command commit, export publication and download; deny at exact expiry and after it.
Keep baseline fixture_clock for reproducible expiry tests; real service time cannot be overridden by client fixture data.
Admin role does not imply evidence access, risk approval or review.
Closure requires treatment.approve plus explicit scope, criteria and decision; evidence VERIFIED, reduced score or risk.accept alone cannot close anything.

ALLOW within assignment; independent mode requires distinct actor

ALLOW only if authorized and different from both assessor and disputed reviewer; otherwise DENY
